==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I have a completely different body. For some reason, I look like a green bald man with pointed ears and brown eyes. I am wearing an all-white business suit underneath a white hooded cloak.

I am the head of a company. The company's name is "Diwali". I have apparently lost and regained control over the company many times over the years.

I can tell that people believe me to be incompetent, but I am prepared to prove that I have what it takes to be CEO. I am working on an invention, when suddenly I feel this unsettling aura of energy that catches me off guard. The energy makes me become lucid.

I can suddenly see colors swirl in the back of my eyelids. The colors are brighter and more beautiful than when I normally see them. I practice trying to control and shape the colors into whatever I imagine, until eventually I fully wake up.
